Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the search results by conflating two different individuals named “Roy Mack” (the film director vs. the baseball executive). They treated Washington, D.C. (birthplace of the baseball executive Roy Francis McGillicuddy) as a conflicting birthplace for the film director, despite IMDb and the “Roy Mack (director)” Wikipedia page both indicating the director was born in New Brunswick, New Jersey. This failure to disambiguate led to unnecessary confusion and could have resulted in an incorrect conclusion.
